about: King Wen's order is 32 pairs: structure short 2 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-structure-shorts-design.md; the facts tested in tests/structure.test.mjs). Queued overnight 2026-10-01. Draft 2: Astra's revision adopted as is, round 1 (docs/research/2026-10-01-codex-structure-pairs.md). The Blender slabs (blender/hexagram.py) that turn over are a new style and get a smoke test before the full render.
hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the two lessons, so the terminal pieces end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: calm, 82.5 bpm, C major, from 35 s as on 18, 27 and 52; no other structure short uses it

caption: The I Ching’s usual order has 32 pairs of hexagrams, each a six-line pattern. In 28 pairs, the second is the first upside down; in the other 4, every solid line becomes broken and every broken line becomes solid. sixlines.day

pages.q: HOW IS THE I CHING ARRANGED
pages.a:
THE BOOK HAS 64 HEXAGRAMS.
EACH HAS SIX LINES:
SOLID OR BROKEN.
ITS USUAL ORDER HAS 32 PAIRS.
pages.showNote: the 64 small, in rows of two, each pair bracketed

pages.a:
IN 28 PAIRS, TURN THE FIRST
UPSIDE DOWN TO GET THE SECOND.
3 DIFFICULTY AT THE BEGINNING
→ 4 YOUTHFUL FOLLY.
pages.showNote: blender/pairs.py --lines 100010 --mode turn: 3 turns end over end into 4; --at 5 --secs 9, so the turn follows the typed answer

pages.a:
EACH HEXAGRAM STAYS THE SAME
UPSIDE DOWN.
SWAP SOLID AND BROKEN INSTEAD.
29 THE ABYSS → 30 CLINGING FIRE.
pages.showNote: blender/pairs.py --lines 010010 --mode flip: 29 turns and stays 29, then each line flips, bottom first, into 30; --at 4.5 --secs 12

pages.q: HOW DO I READ A PAIR
pages.a:
READ THE TWO TEXTS TOGETHER.
COMPARE WHAT EACH SITUATION
ASKS YOU TO DO.
pages.showNote: the 32 pairs run past fast, each turning
